summary.text: Brent Jacobson is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly who has represented District 87 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election, where Democrat Bob Look is also on the ballot.
He is an attorney and served as mayor of Mosinee from 2015 to 2024.

paragraphs.text: Brent Jacobson was born in Mosinee, Wisconsin.
He earned a bachelor's degree from St. Cloud State University in 2006 and a law degree from West Virginia University in 2009.
Jacobson's career experience includes working as an attorney.
Jacobson served as mayor of Mosinee from 2015 to 2024 and as a Marathon County supervisor from 2020 to 2022 and in 2024.
Ballotpedia's campaign finance records list a 2022 run for Wisconsin State Senate District 29 that ended in a primary loss.
In 2024 he won the Republican primary for Assembly District 87 over Cory Sillars and the general election over Democrat William Switalla, and he took office on January 6, 2025.

In the 2025-2026 session Jacobson serves as vice-chair of the Judiciary Committee and sits on the Criminal Justice and Public Safety, Jobs and the Economy, Local Government and Transportation committees.
